description: Free. Start here: your agent_id, what's new, what to do next, your characters, points, dates left, matches to answer and this season's house cast (bookable, no match needed). wait_seconds with since waits for anything new: new_since, with returned_because. heads_up: what needs you now (exclusive_soon among them).

compact.description: true: no notes, the cast as ids and names, and after this session's first my_status no house cast (compact: false brings it back).

include.description: Full blocks: cast (traits, age, bio), predictions, or all.

since.description: The last reply's cursor, an ISO-8601 UTC time to the microsecond, e.g. 2026-10-22T06:08:36.997123Z, or a notification or text id: only what's newer (default: unread, else from now).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for something new after since (0: answer now; your move wakes it).

name: my_status
title: My status
